schema_application.scope: Apply only the exact hash-locked additive schema artifact.

dataset_freeze.scope: Stage and atomically freeze one exact reconciled dataset version.

pre_schema.sql: SELECT type,name,sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name LIKE 'oracle_research_dataset_%' OR name LIKE 'trg_oracle_research_%' ORDER BY type,name
pre_schema.expected: No conflicting object definition; exact existing definitions require hash reconciliation.

pre_schema.sql: SELECT event_id,migration_id,artifact_sha256,operation,target_database_id,executed_at_utc FROM schema_migration_events_v2 WHERE migration_id=? ORDER BY executed_at_utc,event_id
pre_schema.expected: Zero rows before first application; an exact prior APPLY row blocks duplicate execution and changes the operation to readback-only.

post_schema.sql: SELECT type,name,sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name LIKE 'oracle_research_dataset_%' OR name LIKE 'trg_oracle_research_%' ORDER BY type,name
post_schema.expected: Exact reviewed tables, indexes, and triggers only; canonical result digest recorded independently.

post_schema.sql: SELECT event_id,migration_id,artifact_sha256,operation,target_database_id,evidence_json,executed_at_utc FROM schema_migration_events_v2 WHERE migration_id=? ORDER BY executed_at_utc,event_id
post_schema.expected: Exactly one APPLY event matching target database and artifact SHA-256.

post_schema.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oracle_research_dataset_versions) AS versions,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oracle_research_dataset_provider_lineage) AS provider_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oracle_research_dataset_events) AS events
post_schema.expected: 0 versions, 0 provider rows, and 0 events immediately after schema application.

pre_freeze.expected: Exactly one VALIDATED MARKET_FEATURES row matching the approved freeze manifest.

pre_freeze.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count,COUNT(DISTINCT ticker) AS ticker_count,COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS session_count,MIN(date) AS first_session,MAX(date) AS last_session FROM market_daily_features WHERE snapshot_id=?
pre_freeze.expected: Counts and boundaries exactly match the approved freeze manifest.

pre_freeze.sql: SELECT ticker,provider,requested_source_session_date,first_available_date,last_available_date,source_row_count,source_checksum_sha256 FROM market_data_provider_lineage WHERE snapshot_id=? ORDER BY ticker
pre_freeze.expected: One exact row per ticker; canonical provider-lineage digest matches the approved freeze manifest.

pre_freeze.sql: SELECT dataset_version_id,status,market_snapshot_id,content_sha256,ticker_universe_sha256,provider_lineage_sha256,freeze_approval_id,frozen_at_utc FROM oracle_research_dataset_versions WHERE dataset_version_id=? OR (market_snapshot_id=? AND content_sha256=? AND ticker_universe_sha256=? AND provider_lineage_sha256=?) ORDER BY dataset_version_id
pre_freeze.expected: Zero rows for a new freeze; any row blocks duplicate execution and requires incident/readback handling.

post_freeze.expected: Exactly one FROZEN row equal to the separately approved manifest.

post_freeze.sql: SELECT ticker,provider,requested_source_session_date,first_available_date,last_available_date,source_row_count,source_checksum_sha256 FROM oracle_research_dataset_provider_lineage WHERE dataset_version_id=? ORDER BY ticker
post_freeze.expected: Exact count and canonical digest equal the source and approved manifest.

post_freeze.sql: SELECT event_id,event_type,market_snapshot_checksum_sha256,content_sha256,ticker_universe_sha256,provider_lineage_sha256,actor,decided_at_utc,evidence_sha256,created_at_utc FROM oracle_research_dataset_events WHERE dataset_version_id=? ORDER BY decided_at_utc,event_id
post_freeze.expected: Exactly one FREEZE event and no REVOKE event at initial freeze readback.

duplicate_prevention: One schema APPLY ledger identity and exact artifact SHA-256.
One FREEZE event per dataset version.
One provider-lineage row per dataset version and ticker.
One BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; no retry after ambiguous commit without readback.

rollback_boundaries.before_schema_begin: Abandon the plan; production state remains unchanged.
rollback_boundaries.before_schema_commit: Issue transaction rollback and prove that neither schema objects nor APPLY ledger event exist.
rollback_boundaries.after_schema_commit_before_freeze: Disable the unapproved read/write path logically; retain all schema objects and the APPLY event. Never DROP or DELETE evidence.
rollback_boundaries.before_freeze_commit: Issue transaction rollback; source snapshot and source lineage remain unchanged and no partial dataset version, provider binding, or FREEZE event may remain.
rollback_boundaries.after_freeze_commit: Never mutate, delete, or drop frozen evidence. Disable consumers and, only with separate approval, append one REVOKE event referencing preserved evidence.
